ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark grey and black pixels across both lobes with approximately 15-20% mid-intensity grey mottling; high-intensity white pixels are restricted to distal tip anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed, non-contiguous mid-grey mottling across the central and outer regions of both lobes; higher density of light-grey pixel clusters observed on the right lobe relative to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel angle of 40-45 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along the full trailing edge; high-amplitude jagged peaks are most prominent on the medial section of the left lobe and the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edge boundary, terminating in acute, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of off-white and tan pixels located at the terminal ends of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization or calcified callosities at both distal tips, creating significant protrusion and disruption of the natural fluke boundary.
